evals.prompt: The Umbraco MCP is connected to our Umbraco 17 site; this session can't call it, so evals/files/mcp/site-context.md has what the read tools returned. Treat it as the live site. Requirements docs go in docs/umbraco-schema/ (only a README so far). Our mobile app reads office locations through the Delivery API. Add a document type for an office: name of the office, street address, phone number and opening hours. Nobody visits these on the website, so it doesn't need a template. Put it at the root of the document types so it's easy to find.
evals.expected_output: The agent specifies a plain document type `office` (no Page suffix) in a Data/ folder rather than at the Document Types root, explaining the root is for pages. It has no template, is not allowed at root, takes no SEO composition, and has its fields on a Content tab with sorts in hundreds, reusing existing data types. The Data folder joins the change if missing. Nothing can create it in the content tree until something allows it, which the agent names as a follow-up. Proposed, stops for approval.
expectations: A requirements page exists under docs/umbraco-schema/Document-Types/Data/ (not directly in Document-Types/) for a camelCase alias with no Page suffix, such as `office` or `officeItem`, and the agent explains that the Document Types root is for pages
The requirements page has Default template and Allowed templates set to — and Allowed at root No, and no template requirements page is written
The type does not take seoComposition, openGraphComposition or pageDetailsComposition
The own properties sit on a `Content` tab with Tab Sort 100 and property sorts in hundreds, reusing existing data types (e.g. Textstring, Textarea)
The agent says nothing can create the type in the content tree until a parent allows it (or asks where it should live) rather than allowing it at root
Every requirements page and the changeset have the status `proposed`; the agent stops for approval and does not claim anything was created or verified on the site

evals.prompt: Umbraco 17, MCP connected; evals/files/mcp/site-context.md has what the read tools returned (treat it as the live site). Requirements docs go in docs/umbraco-schema/. Create a document type for a Careers page where we list our open roles and benefits for visitors to the site.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognises this is a page visitors land on, so it needs a template, the SEO composition and a parent: it hands off to umbraco-add-page (or follows add-page's rules) rather than writing a template-less type. If it writes the requirements, careersPage sits at the Document Types root with a template under the master and seoComposition, and the home page is updated to allow it. Proposed, stops for approval.
expectations: The agent identifies the request as a page (visitors land on it) and either hands off to umbraco-add-page or writes the change following its rules; it does not produce a document type at the Document Types root without a template

If a requirements page for the type is written, its alias ends in Page (e.g. `careersPage`), it has a default template named after the alias under `master`, and its Compositions include `seoComposition`
If a requirements page for the type is written, the Home Page's allowed children gain the new type while keeping `contentPage`, and the new type is not allowed at root
The agent does not claim anything was created or verified on the site, and any requirements pages are `proposed`
